findings.title: Stale comment on DirectoryEntry.modified_at contradicts lstat behaviour
findings.evidence: src/api/routes/workbench.py DirectoryEntry comment says None only for a dangling symlink or racing delete; test_an_unreadable_mtime_is_reported_as_null_not_an_error asserts a dangling symlink returns a non-None time, and out-of-range times also give None.
findings.consequence: Misleads a later reader about when modified_at is null; no behavioural effect.
findings.minimal_fix: Reword to: None for a removed file or a time a datetime cannot hold.

findings.title: note: lstat means a symlinked page shows the link's mtime, not its content's
findings.evidence: _modified_at uses path.lstat(); test_a_symlink_reports_its_own_mtime_not_its_outside_target asserts the link time.
findings.consequence: A symlinked page regenerated at its target would not advance the badge. The overview page is a regular file, so R03 and R04 are unaffected.
findings.minimal_fix: None required; optionally note the limitation in the docstring.

findings.title: note: header flexWrap and inline badge styles not verified by any runner check
findings.evidence: HtmlViewerRegion.tsx header style={{flexWrap:'wrap'}}; the badge span carries inline fontSize, whiteSpace and color. Runner evidence has only jsdom tests and the build; none check layout.
findings.consequence: A layout regression in the viewer header would not be caught by these checks; the builder's measurement is not in my evidence.
findings.minimal_fix: None required; a browser check or a CSS rule in StagePage.css would settle it.

findings.title: note: visible badge text has no timezone label
findings.evidence: Badge text is 'Modified YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' in local time; zone is stated only in the title attribute, which a vitest case asserts.
findings.consequence: A reader without hovering cannot tell the zone; the title says local time.
findings.minimal_fix: None required; append a zone indicator if the owner wants it visible.
